No production user input reaches this test-only dependency. Deferred to preserve Miniflare API compatibility while a separate upstream tooling update is assessed; CI runs synthetic tests only, exposes no Vitest/Miniflare UI, and production bundle graph checks exclude Undici. Rechecked 2026-10-04.
